verdict.rationale: Airweave publishes a live OpenAPI spec, verified by probe, and documents API-driven workflows: a single search endpoint over collections, SDK calls such as client.source_connections.create, and webhooks offered as an alternative to polling the API. An agent-friendly llms.txt with Markdown page access confirms the API is well documented for programmatic and agent use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the full product lifecycle via the API.
